Maya K: Quick check — PR #582 adds a unified retry policy for SDKs. Before I merge, can folks agree on defaults across node/go/python and a brief guideline for 429 vs 5xx vs streaming reconnects? cc @Aditya R @Samir

Aditya R: Can you paste the prop config?

Maya K: Current proposal:
```
retries: 6
baseDelayMs: 100
maxDelayMs: 10000
jitter: "full"
retryOn: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504]
useRetryAfter: true
```

Samir: Two notes:
- full jitter is good (avoid thundering herd)
- parse and honor Retry-After for 429 (seconds and HTTP-date)

Lia: For streaming chat: don't auto-retry whole request. Support resume tokens. If token available, reconnect+resume, else bubble error to caller.

Maya K: For non-streaming writes: only auto-retry non-idempotent ops when client supplies an Idempotency-Key header (uuidv4 recommended).

Aditya R: Language differences: node low-latency apps prefer baseDelay 50ms; go/python keep 100ms. Also reduce max retries for interactive sync to 4.

Samir: Proposed presets:
- bulk/background: retries=6, base=100ms, max=10s
- interactive sync: retries=4, base=node=50ms, go/python=100ms, max=2000ms

Maya K: How to treat 429 with no Retry-After? Exponential backoff or treat as heavier throttle?

Lia: If missing header, treat as soft throttle: backoff = jitteredExp(base*2^n) but ensure first retry >=250ms to avoid tight loops.

Aditya R: Also handle 401 mid-stream: try one reauth+resume, else escalate. Don't blindly re-send POSTs without idempotency key.

Maya K: I'll add pseudocode in docs for Retry-After parsing:
```
if (resp.headers['retry-after']) {
  delta = parseRetryAfter(resp.headers['retry-after'])
  delay = clamp(delta*1000, baseDelayMs, maxDelayMs)
} else {
  delay = jitteredExponential(baseDelayMs, attempt, maxDelayMs)
}
```

Samir: Server-side helpful header: X-Idempotency-Status: accepted|duplicate|expired — optional but useful for client debugging.

Lia: Streaming resume API example: `?resume_token=...&offset=...`. Clients must persist last acked token until commit.

Aditya R: Tests: add flaky 429/500 simulator in integration tests emitting Retry-After intermittently; test token refresh race scenarios.

Maya K: Actions:
- Maya: update PR with two presets and language defaults + Retry-After parsing
- Aditya: add unit test for interactive timeouts (node baseDelay=50)
- Samir: open server issue to add optional X-Idempotency-Status
- Lia: add streaming resume test harness

Samir: :thumbsup: will review updates

Aditya R: LGTM once tests land. Note: UUIDv4 preferred but any high-entropy key is acceptable.

devex-bot: PR 582 CI passed — all checks green

Maya K: merging in ~30m if no objections :rocket:

Lia: no infra objections. Please add short README snippets for Idempotency-Key and streaming resume.

Samir: Add example for parsing Retry-After date strings in docs; it's tripped us before.

Maya K: Will do, thanks everyone!
